splitAcquisition: Buy at floor1 for160P before training; otherwise receive free after8 if not already owned. Never equip duplicate marks.
powerAcquisition: Start wing+abyss; transition requested pair only after all parts owned: fallen after5, king after10, judge after15. No buyPower UI exists in prototype; do not grant missing powers.
low: Training cumulative spend <=20% of legitimately earned P including initial180; one pass talent/feather/destruction/ultimate per floor, no minimum reserve. Power fragment upgrades stop atLv2. Mark purchase160 is included in total investment but not training budget.
standard: Previous growth: owned powers as affordable toLv5; one training pass talent/feather/destruction/ultimate if P > cost+100. Split is purchased before growth.
high: Owned powers as affordable toLv5; repeated balanced round-robin talent/feather/destruction/ultimate training while affordable, reserve0; no extra P/claims/grinding.
allRoutes: Fresh local campaign; no developer flags, no main resource transfer; stop on first defeat/timeout. No retries counted as wins. Every result and unspent resources retained.
randomness: Runtime seeded PRNG is used, including real floor and Stella/EX offsets. Same route seed across equipment/tier/strategy/variant. Paired counterfactual branches replay their starting PRNG, never use future RNG in action selection.
damage: Received is sum engine enemyDamage (may include lethal overkill); HP loss recorded independently as 1-final internal HP/base HP. Guard heal is rounded internal vitality from actual log, not displayed maxHP under fallen multiplier. Prevented damage not inferred by reversing rounded damage.
